name: gladys-warp-charger
description: Gladys Assistant external integration for Tinkerforge WARP chargers (WARP1 to WARP4, firmware 2.x) over their local HTTP API: state, vehicle, power, current allowed, session energy, energy index with a plausibility guard, charge mode; optional start and charging current, bounded and off by default, stop never held back. Unofficial, not affiliated with Tinkerforge.
